scope: Current production Maths Year 6-equivalent roster and entitlement-source audit
privacy: Aggregate counts only; no student IDs or credentials recorded in this evidence file.

currentRoster.interpretation: No current production student is simultaneously assigned to both an ordinary Year 6 Maths batch and an L3 Maths 11+ batch. The duplicate Year 6/L3 navigation observed in the browser is therefore not explained by dual current batch enrolment.

l3AccessSourceAudit.interpretation: All current L3 students have at least one Year 6 canonical lesson entitlement or PreLesson entitlement even though none has a concurrent Year 6 batch assignment. This proves an entitlement-derived Year 6 view can coexist with the L3 teaching view unless the final navigation response enforces the equivalent-view invariant. The SAT-range query found no current L3 student with a Y6M51..Y6M69 entitlement at audit time, so this evidence does not attribute the duplicate specifically to a SAT entitlement.

runtimeRuleValidatedByAudit.reason: Presentation must be derived from programme/equivalent-view rules at the final response boundary rather than by exposing every entitlement-derived curriculum alias as a separate teaching card.

closureBoundary: Production roster and entitlement-source audit is complete. The navigation incident remains pending owner browser verification of the final-boundary deployment on representative live students.
